timestamp_targets.condition: Only changed enabled consent; genuine original Scheduling time.
First genuine completed/cancelled settlement only; same original native commit time, preserved literally thereafter.
Exact copy of the same original run anchor. Not the current later origin issuance clock.

hash_targets: Only complete physical SHA fields and the exact digest component of their existing SourceOrigin physical keys. Every occurrence must bind a declared earlier whole target or separately qualified actual canonical Stop/cancellation receipt. All DAG edges and whole schemas checked independently.
source_binding: owner_source_ref/sha256 authenticates original owner/resource before Stop; actual substitution authenticates actual original time/value/result afterward. It is not a fabricated hash of a future value.
fixed_reason_hash: Computed before Stop from exact derived resulting native reason UTF8; null iff native reason null.
full_domain: Check all possible actual timestamp string and lowercase64hex outputs under the installed codec/schema; all other fields are exact literals or exact original numeric assignments. Unknown or nonconforming source domain rejects before Stop.
original_operation_identity: Every leaf is independently copied/fixed from actual original C-source and reservations before Stop; no runtime identity/text/number slot.
retirement_separate_domain: Later Janitor compaction has its own complete exact preimage/candidate admission before mutation. Its timestamp is not a cancellation FutureSlot or a new run_completion anchor.
